result.detail: HPO 2026-09-02 annotations give 19,133 disease-to-phenotype edges (610 of 2,489 graph diseases) and a protein-to-phenotype layer (15,390 edges over 245 kinases, 4,487 phenotype nodes). On 1,223 cold diseases (at most one training pair; 172 test positives) cold AUPRC is 0.2446 reference, 0.2642 with disease-to-phenotype only and 0.3072 with both, while macro/micro move 0.4744 to 0.4899/0.4080.
